sections.Profile:
The "Horsefeathers" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in January 1952, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This unique machine features a head-to-head configuration, allowing two players to compete simultaneously on separate playfields.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing
